summary: Project to deploy an Internet Computer website and support connecting a custom domain (GoDaddy / shivaritaglobal.com) via required frontend asset files.
architectural_notes: To enable custom domain linking on ICP, add frontend src/.well-known/ic-domains (no extension) containing the domain string (e.g., shivaritaglobal.com) and add frontend src/ic-assets.json with a rule to include .well-known assets.
known_issues: Previous attempt to connect www.shivaritaglobal.com to the ICP site failed with: "The AI couldn't implement your request. Please simplify or rephrase your prompt."

existing_features.title: In `frontend/src`, add a `.well-known` directory (if it does not already exist) and create a file named `ic-domains` (no file extension) at `frontend/src/.well-known/ic-domains` with the exact content: `"shivaritaglobal.com"`.
In `frontend/src`, create a file named `ic-assets.json` with the exact contents: `[{"match":.well-known","ignore":false}]` (including brackets/quotes exactly as provided).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add custom domain connection support by adding frontend .well-known/ic-domains and ic-assets.json for shivaritaglobal.com

projectName: Add IC custom domain asset files for shivaritaglobal.com
